name: Kyou no Jihaku Gohan
source:
The police have captured Aoki, the boss of a hacker organization.

However, he's planted a government data leak program that's set to activate in 7 days.

If left unchecked, citizens' personal information will be scattered everywhere. The only way to deactivate the program is through a 5-digit code that only he knows.

...Well, the criminal bastard seems to like my cooking. Might as well strike a deal.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13446]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
警方抓获了黑客组织的老大青木。

然而，他已经制定了一个政府数据泄露计划，该计划将在7天内启动。

如果不加以控制，公民的个人信息将会散落各处。停用该程序的唯一方法是通过只有他知道的5位数代码。

……嗯，那个混蛋好像很喜欢我做的菜。或许还可以达成协议。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13446]Novelgame[/url]]
